acceptance_checks: scripts/shiki_provider.py defines dependency-free GitHub-compatible provider configuration for provider kind, host, remote protocol, repo slug, web/API base URLs, SSH host, repo API paths, canonical remote URL, and GH_HOST environment mapping.

shiki init, shiki start, shiki bootstrap-platform, and the deprecated shiki bootstrap-github expose --provider, --github-host, --github-api-url, and --remote-protocol flags while preserving GitHub.com HTTPS defaults.
scripts/shiki_git.py uses provider-aware canonical remote generation and remote matching while preserving existing-origin mismatch hard-fail unless --adopt-existing-repo is passed.
scripts/shiki_github.py keeps gh as the backend and injects GH_HOST for GitHub Enterprise-compatible provider configs without globally mutating the process environment.
Executed init writes provider fields into .shiki/repo.json, and legacy repo records without provider fields remain valid as GitHub.com HTTPS.
Dry-run output lists provider, host, remote protocol, canonical origin, API base URL, filesystem, git, GitHub repo, secret, branch protection, default-branch, commit, and push mutations.
scripts/validate_shiki.py validates provider config defaults, invalid provider/protocol/repo/host cases, repo.json provider fields, module inclusion, and provider test presence.

scripts/test_shiki_provider_config.sh covers provider config basics, GitHub.com/Enterprise HTTPS/SSH remotes, remote matching, legacy repo config, dry-run output, executed mocked init repo.json fields, GH_HOST injection, origin mismatch, and CLI help.

docs/agents/github-provider-config.md and related agent docs document GitHub.com defaults, SSH/HTTPS, GitHub Enterprise host/API URL, GH_HOST auth expectations, repo.json fields, legacy compatibility, and non-goals.
Verification bundle passes: validate_shiki, py_compile, scripts/test_shiki_*.sh, provider smoke, and git diff --check.

scope: Make GitHub provider host, remote protocol, and GitHub Enterprise-compatible configuration explicit, validated, documented, and testable while preserving GitHub-first behavior.
title: Make GitHub host / protocol / provider configurable
